camel_example: aliyun agentcore POST /workspaces/ws-2f5f9c5a8d0e4c3b/memorystores/customer-memory/events --region cn-hangzhou --header "Content-Type=application/x-www-form-urlencoded" --body 'body={scope={sessionId=session-001}, events=[{data={callId=call-001, summary=用户计划周末徒步旅行。, role=user, parentScope={sessionId=session-001}, parentEventId=evt-2f5f9c5a8d0e4c3b, eventIds=[evt-2f5f9c5a8d0e4c3b], content=[{type=text}]}, type=message, timestamp=1758614400000}]}' --version 2026-08-04 --force
description_en: Writes messages, summaries, or session fork events in batches. Each batch supports 1 to 100 events and returns the write result for each event in the same order as the request. A successful request does not indicate that every event is written successfully or that memory extraction is complete. The session title and metadata are set only when the session is created for the first time. Subsequent writes do not update existing session information
description_zh: 批量写入消息、摘要或会话分支事件。每批支持 1～100 条，逐条返回写入结果，顺序与请求一致。请求成功不表示每条事件均写入成功，也不表示记忆提取已经完成。session 仅在首次创建会话时设置标题和元数据，后续写入不更新已有会话信息
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore create-events --workspace-id ws-2f5f9c5a8d0e4c3b --memory-store-name customer-memory --biz-body '{"scope":{"sessionId":"session-001"},"events":[{"data":{"callId":"call-001","summary":"用户计划周末徒步旅行。","role":"user","parentScope":{"sessionId":"session-001"},"parentEventId":"evt-2f5f9c5a8d0e4c3b","eventIds":["evt-2f5f9c5a8d0e4c3b"],"content":[{"type":"text"}]},"type":"message","timestamp":1758614400000}]}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateEvents

parameters.help_en: The name of the memory store
parameters.name: memory_store_name

fields.help_en: The call ID. This field is required for tool_call and tool_result events, or message events with the role set to tool. It associates the call intent, actual execution, and feedback
fields.help_zh: tool_call、tool_result 或 role=tool 的 message 必填；关联调用意图、实际执行和反馈
fields.name: call_id

fields.help_en: The JSON parameter values. This field is required for tool_call blocks. Unparsed raw strings can be retained
fields.help_zh: tool_call 必填的 JSON 参数值；可保留未解析的原始字符串
fields.name: arguments

fields.help_en: The logical call ID. This field is required for tool_call blocks
fields.help_zh: tool_call 必填的逻辑调用标识
fields.name: call_id

fields.help_en: The access format identifier. This field is required for opaque blocks. Saving the format does not mean that its content can be interpreted or used across platforms
fields.help_zh: opaque 必填的接入格式标识；保存不代表能解释或跨平台使用其内容
fields.name: format

fields.help_en: The tool name. This field is required for tool_call blocks. This content block only expresses the call intent
fields.help_zh: tool_call 必填的工具名称；本内容块只表达调用意图
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The actual text. This field is required for text and reasoning blocks
fields.help_zh: text、reasoning 必填的实际文本
fields.name: text

fields.help_en: The content block type. This field determines the required fields
fields.help_zh: 内容块类型；必填字段由本字段决定
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The JSON value. This field is required for json and opaque blocks. The data field is not used for opaque blocks
fields.help_zh: json、opaque 必填的 JSON 值；opaque 不使用 data 字段
fields.name: value

fields.help_en: The ordered content blocks. This field is required for message and tool_result events. Use a text block for plain text. This can be an empty array if the tool has no output
fields.help_zh: message、tool_result 必填的有序内容块；纯文本使用 text 块，工具无输出时可为空数组
fields.name: content

fields.help_en: The list of visible event IDs referenced by the summary. This list cannot be empty
fields.help_zh: 摘要所引用的可见事件标识列表，不能为空
fields.name: event_ids

fields.help_en: The anchor event ID of the parent session. This field is required for session_fork events. The child session continues from the valid context at this anchor and does not inherit interactions after the anchor
fields.help_zh: session_fork 必填的父会话锚点；子会话从该锚点处有效上下文继续，不继承锚点之后的交互
fields.name: parent_event_id

fields.help_en: The business agent ID
fields.help_zh: 业务 Agent ID
fields.name: agent_id

fields.help_en: The exact session ID
fields.help_zh: 精确定位的会话 ID
fields.name: session_id

fields.help_en: The business team ID
fields.help_zh: 业务团队 ID
fields.name: team_id

fields.help_en: The business user ID. This is not the platform tenant identity
fields.help_zh: 业务用户 ID；不是平台租户身份
fields.name: user_id

fields.help_en: The business scope of the parent session. This field is required for session_fork events. The event is written to the child session, and the requested scope is the child session
fields.help_zh: session_fork 必填的父会话业务定位；事件写在子会话，请求 scope 为子会话
fields.name: parent_scope

fields.help_en: The message role. This field is required for message events
fields.help_zh: message 必填的消息角色
fields.name: role

fields.example: 用户计划周末徒步旅行。
fields.help_en: The human-readable summary. This field is optional for context_update events
fields.help_zh: context_update 可选的可读摘要
fields.name: summary

fields.help_en: The event-specific data. Use the corresponding fields based on the type. For conditional requirements, refer to the description of each field
fields.help_zh: 事件专属数据；按 type 使用对应字段，条件必填要求见各字段说明
fields.name: data

fields.help_en: The actual occurrence time provided by the client as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds. This is the only source for business sorting. Identical values do not indicate a known sequence, and the array position does not imply a business order
fields.help_zh: 客户端提供的实际发生时间，Unix 毫秒整数；唯一业务排序来源，相同值不表示已知先后，数组位置不赋予业务顺序
fields.name: timestamp

fields.help_en: The event type. This determines the applicable fields and conditional requirements for the data
fields.help_zh: 事件类型；决定 data 的适用字段及条件必填性
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: A list of 1 to 100 events. The request body cannot exceed 1 MiB
fields.help_zh: 1 至 100 条事件；请求 Body 不超过 1 MiB
fields.name: events

fields.help_en: The business agent ID
fields.help_zh: 业务 Agent ID
fields.name: agent_id

fields.help_en: The exact session ID
fields.help_zh: 精确定位的会话 ID
fields.name: session_id

fields.help_en: The business team ID
fields.help_zh: 业务团队 ID
fields.name: team_id

fields.help_en: The business user ID. This is not the platform tenant identity
fields.help_zh: 业务用户 ID；不是平台租户身份
fields.name: user_id

fields.help_en: The exact session to which all events belong
fields.help_zh: 全部事件所属的精确会话
fields.name: scope

fields.help_en: The JSON metadata of the session
fields.help_zh: 会话 JSON 元数据
fields.name: metadata

fields.help_en: The session title. It can be up to 256 characters in length
fields.help_zh: 会话标题，最多 256 字符
fields.name: title

fields.help_en: The information saved when the first event is successfully written. It is not overwritten by subsequent writes
fields.help_zh: 首次成功写入自有事件时保存的描述，之后不覆盖
fields.name: session

results.description_en: The write result for each item. A successful top-level response does not indicate that every item was successful
results.description_zh: 逐条写入结果，外层成功不代表每项成功

error.description_en: The error for the failed item

eventId.description_en: The event ID generated after the event is successfully saved
eventId.description_zh: 成功保存后的事件 ID

receivedAt.description_en: The time when the event reached the server after being successfully saved, in Unix milliseconds
receivedAt.description_zh: 成功保存后的服务端到达时间，Unix 毫秒整数

status.description_en: The status. Valid values: STORED and FAILED

requestId.description_en: The request ID used for troubleshooting

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful. For batch operations, you must still check the result of each item
success.description_zh: 请求是否成功；批量接口仍需检查各项结果
